ruleset.name: dev-team-java-default
ruleset.description: Default Java ruleset for the dev-team static-analysis integration: wraps PMD's documented quickstart set and excludes generated-output directories so the full-repo /code-review walk reports no duplicate or noise findings on copied sources. Projects override this file entirely by placing a pmd-ruleset.xml at their repo root; custom rulesets carry their own exclude-pattern entries. Test sources deliberately run the same rules as production code.
